# Isolated manual single-panel validation package

This file exists only as an upstream-layout discovery marker for the adapter.

Source: existing downstream test artifact `MAIN_FIG_P7_05_1.png` from the real-paper run of
DOI 10.1002/adfm.75805. No external paper, PDF, SI, or chem-literature file was consulted or modified.
Manual anchors and ordered pixel path are recorded in `annotation/MANUAL_ANNOTATION.json` and
`digitization_overrides.json`. They are validation inputs, not experimental data or automatic results.
